items.title: Felony charges for citizen deleting phone data at US Border

items.title_en: Felony Charges for Citizen Who Deleted Phone Data at US Border

items.title: I accidentally logged hundreds of thousands of phone calls to military bases

items.title_en: Researcher accidentally logs calls to military bases via E.164.arpa hijack
items.summary: A researcher accidentally hijacked E.164.arpa ENUM lookups, logging hundreds of thousands of phone calls to military bases, exposing a largely ignored and insecure infrastructure.

items.title: I'm becoming AI-blind
items.title_zh: 成为“AI盲”：当精致的AI文本让人无法理解
items.title_en: Becoming AI-Blind: When Polished AI Text Stops Making Sense
items.summary: The author describes becoming 'AI-blind'—an inability to meaningfully parse AI-generated text—sparking significant discussion about the psychological and practical effects of AI writing on readers.

items.title: Stop Making TUIs

items.title_en: Stop Making TUIs: Ptacek Urges Native UIs for All Tools
items.summary: Thomas Ptacek argues that coding agents have made native UI development so cheap that developers should build real GUIs for even small personal tools, a view endorsed by Simon Willison.
